name: Kiss in Hell
source:
"Wouldn’t it be ecstatic, if I were in your secret otome dreams?"

Steamy anime otome dreams haunt you every night, each one more romantic, more intense, and more dangerously tempting than the last.
A mysterious, seductive man appears—his gaze burning with desire and anime-style passion.

"I must be crazy, dreaming of the same otome man again!"

You wake up breathless, heart racing, only to find yourself trapped in a mansion straight out of an anime otome fantasy.
Before you can process it, a voice calls out—

"Think you can handle me with that small body of yours?"

Surrounded by demon lords, each brimming with raw desire and untamed anime passion, you must navigate the dangerous otome world where every choice shapes your fate.

Can you survive this anime otome romance, or will you fall deeper into their seductive grasp?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.p31client]Google Play[/url]]
